incidents.name: Pythia staking reward re-claim
incidents.notes: claimRewards() paid out against the caller's current staking-token balance without settling or resetting reward accounting when that balance was transferred, so the attacker recycled the same stake through fresh helper contracts and claimed the reward pool ~30 times in one transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking contract 0xe2910b29... created by 0xae730f689ac162440536ce006caff10fe759ab52 on 2024-09-02T17:31:59Z, 10 hours before the attack; attack sender 0xd861e6f1... is unrelated to the creator
